answers=[]
def add(i, part, ruling, section, quote):
    answers.append({'id':f'Q{i:02d}','source_passages':[{'section':section,'quotation':quote}],'answer':[{'part':part,'ruling':ruling,'evidence':section}],'support':'supported','evidence':[section]})
add(1,'Rule determination, ties, tokens, Vagabond','A player rules a clearing when they have more total warriors plus buildings there than every other player. Tokens and pawns do not count. An ordinary tie means no one rules; Eyrie wins a tie for most if it has at least one Eyrie piece there. Vagabond cannot rule and cannot prevent another player from ruling.','Actions — Shared movement, crafting and battle','**Rule (2.5):** A player rules a clearing with more total **warriors plus buildings** than each other player. Tokens and pawns do not contribute. Ordinary ties mean nobody rules. Eyrie rule a tie for most if they have at least one Eyrie piece there. Vagabond cannot rule or stop someone else ruling.')
add(2,'Normal movement legality, repeated movement, rivers','Move a positive number of your warriors or pawns along a linking path from one clearing to an adjacent clearing. You must rule the origin, destination, or both, and recheck rule for each move. The same pieces may move repeatedly, including on multiple moves in one action. Rivers are not paths unless an effect says they are.','Actions — Shared movement, crafting and battle','**Move (4.2):** Take any positive number of your warriors/pawns from one clearing along a linking path to an adjacent clearing. You must rule origin or destination or both. Recheck rule for each move. You may move the same pieces repeatedly, including on multiple moves in one action. Rivers are not paths unless an effect explicitly treats them as paths. Moving and placing are different procedures. Vagabond has its own movement exceptions below.')
add(3,'Battle procedure from ambush through removal','Choose a clearing with your warriors or pawn and an enemy defender; rule is unnecessary. Defender may ambush with a clearing-matching card (birds wild); attacker may foil with a matching ambush. If unfoiled, defender deals two immediate hits, then battle ends if attacker has no warriors/pawns left. Resolve before-roll effects (attacker orders if both sides have them), roll: high die is attacker hits, low is defender hits (equal dice equal); rolled hits are capped by that side’s battle warriors, Alliance defender reverses dice, Vagabond uses undamaged swords. Resolve after-roll effects (attacker orders), add extra hits and subtract ignored hits; hits are uncapped by defending warriors. Defenseless defender takes one extra hit if it has no warriors, except Vagabond needs no undamaged swords to avoid defenselessness. For each hit, the hit side chooses a piece to remove, but warriors must all be removed before buildings/tokens. The remover of an enemy building/token scores 1 VP each, even as defender/outside battle. Vagabond takes hits as item damage.','Actions — Battle (4.3)','**Battle (4.3):** Choose a clearing with your warriors or pawn and an enemy there as defender. **Battle does not require you to rule the clearing.** Resolve these six steps:\n\n1. **Ambush:** Defender may play one ambush matching clearing (birds are wild). Attacker may foil it with a matching ambush. Defender\'s card is discarded; a foiled ambush deals no hits. Otherwise defender immediately deals two hits, then discards ambush. If no attacking warriors or pawns remain, battle ends immediately. Ambush hits are not limited by defending warriors.\n2. **Before-roll effects:** Resolve applicable effects; attacker chooses order if both have them.\n3. **Roll:** Higher die is attacker\'s rolled hits, lower defender\'s; equal dice give equal results. Each side\'s rolled hits are capped by its own warriors in battle. Alliance defending reverses the dice; Vagabond uses undamaged swords instead of warriors.\n4. **After-roll effects:** Resolve effects affecting battle that do not say “before rolling”; attacker chooses order if both have them.\n5. **Count hits:** Add extra hits (uncapped by warriors), subtract ignored hits. If defender has no warriors, attacker deals one extra hit for **defenseless**; Vagabond is instead defenseless if it has no undamaged swords.\n6. **Deal hits:** Each hit removes one opposing piece. The side taking hits chooses its own removal order, but **all its warriors must be removed before its buildings/tokens**. It also chooses order of effects triggered by its pieces’ removal. Both sides deal their counted hits; losing warriors does not retroactively change the rolled cap. Whoever removes an enemy building/token scores **one VP each**, even while defending and even outside battle. Vagabond takes hits as item damage instead.')
add(4,'Crafting costs, repeat use, absent items, duplicates','Craft only when faction permits, from hand, paying each bottom-left icon with a crafting piece matching that icon’s suit (suit comes from its clearing). Marquise/Eyrie/Alliance activate one workshop/roost/sympathy per icon, and each such piece only once per turn. Vagabond pays each icon by flipping one face-up undamaged hammer face down; pawn clearing must match every icon, and the pawn may be reused repeatedly. A three-color question-mark icon accepts any suit. An item card cannot be crafted if its matching map-supply token is absent. Only an identical persistent effect already in your own play area blocks crafting another; other players’ copies do not.','Actions — Craft (4.1)','**Craft (4.1):** **Every crafting piece gets its suit from the clearing containing it.** The card’s **bottom-left crafting icons** require pieces of those clearing suits; the card’s own suit does not define the cost. Craft a card from hand when your faction permits.\n\n**Personal duplicate check:** Only an identical persistent effect **in your own play area** prevents you from crafting that effect again. Other players’ copies do not count for this duplicate restriction.\n\n- **Marquise, Eyrie and Alliance cost:** For **each icon**, activate **one workshop, roost or sympathy in a clearing matching that icon’s suit**, respectively. A crafting piece gets its suit from its clearing. Combine eligible pieces as needed, but **each piece may activate only once per turn**.\n- **Vagabond cost and reuse:** The pawn **may activate repeatedly in a turn**. For each icon, **pay by exhausting one face-up, undamaged hammer: flip that hammer face down**. The pawn’s **current clearing must match every icon on the card**. Reusing the pawn never waives the hammer payment per icon. One clearing cannot pay mixed fox/rabbit/mouse icons.\n- A **three-color question-mark icon** accepts any suit.\n\n- Immediate effect (paper box): resolve, then discard the **crafting card**. An item card requires the corresponding **item token** in the map supply, or it cannot be crafted. Take the item token into Crafted Items and score the VP printed on the card, subject to Eyrie exception. The item token stays; the crafting card is discarded. Ordinary factions do not exhaust crafted items as Vagabond does.')
add(5,'Dominance activation and win condition','In your Daylight at 10 or more VP, activate a dominance card from hand into play, remove your score marker, and stop scoring VP. You win at the start of your own Birdsong by ruling three clearings of the matching mouse/rabbit/fox suit, or for bird dominance by ruling two diagonally opposite corner clearings. It does not win immediately upon meeting the condition earlier. An activated card cannot be removed/replaced.','Scoring / Victory Conditions — Dominance (3.3)','**Dominance (3.3):** In own Daylight at **at least 10 VP**, activate a dominance card from hand into play area; remove score marker and stop scoring VP. Cannot remove/replace activated card. At **start of own Birdsong**, win if ruling **three clearings of matching mouse/rabbit/fox suit**, or for **bird dominance, two diagonally opposite corner clearings**. Meeting condition earlier does not immediately win. Dominance cards cannot be crafted, but can be spent for suit. Whenever one would enter discard, put it near map available instead. During own Daylight, spend matching card to take available dominance into hand. Available **bird dominance remains bird**, so payment must be bird; a bird hand card can pay for non-bird dominance. Activation and taking are separate, neither requires a faction action allowance.')
add(6,'Spent dominance card and taking another','Whenever a dominance card would enter discard, place it near the map as available. During your Daylight, spend a matching card to take an available dominance into hand; available bird dominance is still bird, so it requires a bird payment, while a bird hand card can pay for non-bird dominance. Taking it does not activate it.','Scoring / Victory Conditions — Dominance (3.3)','**Dominance (3.3):** In own Daylight at **at least 10 VP**, activate a dominance card from hand into play area; remove score marker and stop scoring VP. Cannot remove/replace activated card. At **start of own Birdsong**, win if ruling **three clearings of matching mouse/rabbit/fox suit**, or for **bird dominance, two diagonally opposite corner clearings**. Meeting condition earlier does not immediately win. Dominance cards cannot be crafted, but can be spent for suit. Whenever one would enter discard, put it near map available instead. During own Daylight, spend matching card to take available dominance into hand. Available **bird dominance remains bird**, so payment must be bird; a bird hand card can pay for non-bird dominance. Activation and taking are separate, neither requires a faction action allowance.')
add(7,'Two-player setup deck, hand, ruins/items, faction order','In a two-player game remove all four dominance cards, shuffle the shared deck, and each player draws three. Cover four R building slots with ruins. Map item supply is 2 boots, 2 bags, 1 crossbow, 1 hammer, 2 swords, 2 tea, 2 coins. Only if Vagabond is present, hide one each R-marked bag, boot, hammer, sword beneath separate ruins, shuffle stacks with identities hidden, and return to empty R slots; without Vagabond ruins have no items. Set up factions in Marquise, Eyrie, Alliance, Vagabond letter order, distinct from turn order.','Setup','**Setup:** Use **Standard Setup**, in this order (Law 5.1):\n\n1. Choose factions; determine starting player and seating randomly. Take faction boards and their listed pieces. Use Fall or Winter. Fall has no special rules; on Winter, the river divides forests just as printed paths do. Rivers are otherwise not paths.\n2. Put score markers at 0.\n3. With two players, remove all four dominance cards. Shuffle shared deck; each player draws **three cards**.\n4. **Ruins and items:** Cover the four R building slots with ruins. The separate map item supply is **2 boots, 2 bags, 1 crossbow, 1 hammer, 2 swords, 2 tea, 2 coins**. Keep the four R-marked ruin items separate from this supply: only Vagabond faction setup hides one each of its R-marked bag, boot, hammer and sword beneath the four ruins, **one item beneath each ruin**. During that Vagabond setup, shuffle the ruin/item stacks and return each to an empty R ruin slot, keeping item identities hidden. Without a Vagabond, ruins contain no items.\n5. The map item supply uses its corresponding spaces near the top of the map.\n6. Distribute overview cards as desired; put battle dice nearby.\n7. Set up factions in their letter order: Marquise, Eyrie, Alliance, Vagabond. Setup order is distinct from turn order.\n\n**Hidden ruin items (only when Vagabond is present, during its faction setup):**\n\n1. Take the four ruins and R-marked bag, boot, hammer and sword. Put **one item beneath each ruin**.\n2. **Shuffle the ruin/item stacks**, keeping identities hidden.\n3. **Return each stack to an empty R ruin slot** on the map. With no Vagabond, leave the four ruins without hidden items.')
add(8,'Keep rule and Field Hospitals','Only Marquise may place pieces in the Keep clearing, though other players may move pieces into it. The Keep cannot be placed again if removed. Whenever any number of Marquise warriors are removed from a clearing, Marquise may spend one card matching that clearing and place those warriors in the Keep clearing instead of supply; this may apply outside battle. Without the Keep there is no hospital destination.','Marquise de Cat — Keep','**Keep:** Only Marquise may **place** pieces in its clearing; other players may **move** pieces into it. The keep cannot be placed again if removed. **Field Hospitals:** Whenever any number of Marquise warriors are removed from a clearing, Marquise may spend one card matching that clearing to place those warriors in the keep clearing instead of supply. This can apply outside battle. Without a keep there is no destination for hospitals.')
add(9,'Marquise Daylight order and actions','First craft with workshops. Then take up to three actions plus one per bird card spent outside an action, in any order/number except Recruit once per turn. Battle is one battle; March is up to two moves and its compound action cannot be interrupted to spend a bird card or act; Recruit places one warrior at each recruiter; Build follows its own full-cost rule; Overwork spends a card matching a sawmill clearing to place one wood there.','Marquise de Cat — Daylight','**Daylight:** First craft with workshops. Then take **up to three actions**, plus **one per bird card spent outside an action**, in any order and number except Recruit’s limit:\n\n- **Battle:** One battle.\n- **March:** Up to two moves; either may use the same or different warriors. Do not interrupt the compound action to spend a bird card or take another action.\n- **Recruit:** One warrior at **each recruiter**; only **once per turn**. If supply cannot fill all recruiters, place maximum available, choosing among eligible recruiters.\n- **Build:** Choose a clearing you rule with open slot and choose building type. Take the leftmost building of that type. Pay cost shown atop its column by removing that many wood from the target clearing or from other ruled clearings linked to it through an unbroken chain of ruled clearings. Place building; score VP on uncovered space. You cannot build without full wood cost, the building and legal slot.\n- **Overwork:** Spend a card matching a sawmill’s clearing to place one wood there.')
add(10,'Marquise build requirements, cost source, track, scoring','Choose a clearing you rule with an open slot and building type. Take the leftmost building of that type; pay the column-top wood cost from the target clearing or from other ruled clearings connected to it by an unbroken chain of ruled clearings. Place it and score VP printed on the uncovered track space. Full wood cost, building availability, and legal slot are required.','Marquise de Cat — Build','- **Build:** Choose a clearing you rule with open slot and choose building type. Take the leftmost building of that type. Pay cost shown atop its column by removing that many wood from the target clearing or from other ruled clearings linked to it through an unbroken chain of ruled clearings. Place building; score VP on uncovered space. You cannot build without full wood cost, the building and legal slot.')
add(11,'Eyrie Birdsong and recovery','Birdsong: if hand empty, Emergency Orders draws one; add one or two hand cards to Decree, at most one bird card, each to any column; then if no roosts on map, place a roost and three warriors in a clearing with fewest warriors where all those pieces can be placed.','Eyrie Dynasties — Birdsong','**Birdsong, in order:**\n\n1. **Emergency Orders:** If hand empty, draw one.\n2. **Add to Decree:** Must add one or two hand cards, **at most one added bird card**. Each goes to any column; columns have no size limit.\n3. **A New Roost:** If no roosts on map, place one roost and three warriors in a clearing with the fewest warriors **where all these pieces can be placed**.')
add(12,'Eyrie Decree resolution','Craft with roosts first, then resolve every Decree card by columns Recruit, Move, Battle, Build; within a column choose card order. Bird is wild. Recruit suit matches a roost clearing and places one warrior at one chosen roost (Charismatic must place two); Move suit matches origin and moves at least one warrior obeying normal path/rule; Battle suit matches battle clearing and initiates with Eyrie warriors vs enemy; Build suit matches target and places a roost in a clearing ruled by Eyrie with open slot and no roost. Any required action not fully completed causes immediate Turmoil; no skipping/continuing.','Eyrie Dynasties — Daylight — resolve the Decree','**Daylight — resolve the Decree:** Craft using roosts first, then resolve **every Decree card**, column by column **Recruit → Move → Battle → Build**. Within one column choose card order freely. Bird is wild. **If any required action cannot be fully completed, immediately enter Turmoil: you cannot skip the card or continue other columns.** Each card requires:\n\n| Decree column | Match the card’s suit to | Required procedure for one card |\n|---|---|---|\n| Recruit | Clearing with a roost | Place **one warrior at one chosen roost** there; Charismatic must instead place **two warriors** there |\n| Move | Origin clearing | Move **at least one warrior**, obeying ordinary path and rule requirements |\n| Battle | Clearing of battle | Initiate a battle there with Eyrie warriors and an enemy |\n| Build | Target clearing | Place one roost in a clearing you rule, with an open slot and **no roost already there** |\n\n**Bird Decree cards are wild in every column:** choose any clearing suit, while still meeting that action’s other requirements.\n\nIf any required action cannot be completed fully for any reason (including warrior/building supply), immediately enter **Turmoil**; do not skip that card or continue other Decree columns.')
add(13,'Turmoil and remaining turn','Lose 1 VP per bird Decree card including both Viziers; discard every Decree card except Viziers; flip current leader face down and choose a face-up replacement (if none, flip all leaders face up first); retuck Viziers into new leader’s columns. Daylight ends, but full normal Evening proceeds: score roost track, draw one plus uncovered bonuses, discard to five. Map warriors/buildings remain.','Eyrie Dynasties — Turmoil','**Turmoil, in order:** Lose one VP per bird Decree card **including both Loyal Viziers**; discard every Decree card except Viziers; flip current leader face down and choose a face-up replacement. If none face up, flip all leaders face up before choosing. Retuck Viziers in new leader’s columns. End Daylight and proceed to the full normal Evening: **score the roost track, draw one plus uncovered bonuses, then discard to five**. **Turmoil does not remove your map warriors or buildings.**')
add(14,'Outrage trigger and payment, no match/full stack','Outrage triggers when another player removes sympathy or moves any warriors into a sympathetic clearing; the player adds one matching hand card (birds count) per affected move, not per warrior. If no matching card including birds, show hand to Alliance, then Alliance draws one deck card into Supporters. If Supporters full, incoming Outrage card is discarded, but payment/no-match draw still occurs. Placing warriors there and moving only Vagabond pawn do not trigger it; battle alone does not unless sympathy is removed.','Woodland Alliance — Outrage','**Outrage:** Each time another player **removes sympathy** or **moves any warriors into a sympathetic clearing**, that player adds one matching hand card (birds count) to Supporters. Moving a group costs one card per affected move, rather than one per warrior. If no matching cards including birds, show hand to Alliance, then Alliance draws one deck card into Supporters. **If Supporters is full, discard the incoming Outrage card; payment or the no-match draw still occurs.** Merely battling there is no trigger unless sympathy is removed; placing warriors there and moving only Vagabond pawn do not trigger it.')
add(15,'Revolt vs Spread Sympathy','Both occur in Birdsong; complete all Revolts before any Spread Sympathy; each may be done any number of times. Each action spends supporters matching target clearing, birds wild. Revolt: choose sympathetic clearing without base matching a base still on board, spend two matching supporters, remove all enemy pieces, score 1 VP per enemy building/token removed, place matching base, warriors equal matching-suit sympathetic clearings including revolt clearing, and one warrior in Officers; Vagabond damages three items. Spread: choose unsympathetic clearing adjacent by path to sympathy (or any if no sympathy), spend cost shown above next token plus one matching supporter if target has at least three warriors of one other player (Martial Law), place sympathy and score uncovered VP; only one sympathy per clearing. Newly spread sympathy cannot support a same-Birdsong revolt.','Woodland Alliance — Birdsong','**Birdsong:** Both Revolt and Spread Sympathy take place **during Birdsong**. Complete **all Revolts before starting any Spread Sympathy**; each may be performed any number of times. **For both actions, every supporter spent must match the target clearing; birds are wild.** Once spreading starts, you cannot return to Revolt this Birdsong, so newly spread sympathy cannot support a same-Birdsong Revolt:\n\n- **Revolt:** Choose sympathetic clearing without a base, matching a base still on your board. Spend **two matching supporters**. **Remove all enemy pieces there and score one VP per enemy building/token removed**; then place matching base. Place warriors there equal to number of sympathetic clearings matching the base’s printed suit (including revolt clearing), and one warrior in Officers box. Score normal VP for removed enemy buildings/tokens. Resolve the effect even if a prompted placement cannot be completed: place the maximum possible, without adding a base-placement prerequisite. Enemy Vagabond damages three items instead of being removed.\n- **Spread Sympathy:** Choose unsympathetic clearing adjacent by path to sympathy; if no sympathy anywhere, choose any clearing. Spend matching supporters shown above next sympathy token. **Martial Law:** add one matching supporter if chosen clearing has at least three warriors of **one other player**. Place token and score uncovered space. Only one sympathy per clearing. Keep’s placement ban still applies.')
add(16,'Train, Organize, base loss','During Daylight, Train by spending a hand card matching a clearing with a base to place one supply warrior in Officers; Supporters cannot pay. In Evening take up to number of officers in operations; officers stay and operations do not consume them. Organize removes one Alliance warrior from an unsympathetic clearing and places sympathy there, scores uncovered VP, with no supporter/adjacency/Martial Law cost but legal token placement required. When a base is removed, discard all supporters matching its clearing including birds, remove half officers rounded up; if no bases remain, reduce supporters to five.','Woodland Alliance — Losing a base; Daylight and Evening','**Losing a base:** Discard all supporters matching its clearing **including birds**, remove half officers **rounded up**. If no bases remain, discard excess supporters down to five. Do this whenever a base is removed.\n\n- **Train during Daylight:** Spend a **hand card** matching a clearing with a base to place one supply warrior in Officers box. Supporters cannot pay Train. Each officer allows one Evening military operation; taking operations does not consume officers.\n\nOrganize spends no supporters and has no sympathy-adjacency requirement or Martial Law cost; it still needs legal token placement.')
add(17,'Refresh, Slip, move, Rest, draw','Birdsong Refresh first counts tea already face up on Refresh track: flip two exhausted items face up per tea then three more; newly refreshed tea grants no same-step bonus. Slip optionally moves to adjacent clearing or forest without exhausting boots, even into hostile warriors, and ignores effects preventing movement out. Daylight Move exhausts one boot plus one extra if destination has any warriors of any Hostile faction; ignores rule, cannot enter forest, and from forest may go only to adjacent clearing. In forest in Evening, Rest repairs all damaged items to Satchel face up and tracks ready tea/coins/bags if space; it does not refresh undamaged exhausted items. Always draw one card plus one per face-up coins on track even after Rest.','Vagabond — Birdsong, Daylight, Evening','1. **Refresh:** First count tea **already face up on Refresh track**; flip two exhausted items face up per counted tea, then three more exhausted items. Tea refreshed during this step gives no extra refresh this step. Refreshing changes face, not damaged status.\n2. **Slip (optional):** Move to an adjacent clearing or forest, exhausting **no boots**, even into hostile warriors. Ignore all effects preventing movement **out of** a clearing.\n\n- **Move:** Exhaust one boot, plus **one extra boot** if destination has any warriors of any Hostile faction (also for forced moves). Ignore rule. **Cannot enter a forest with this action; from a forest you may move only to an adjacent clearing.** Slip has the special free-boot exception.\n\n1. If in forest, **Rest**: return all damaged items to Satchel and flip them face up; ready tea/coins/bags move to tracks if able. This does not refresh undamaged exhausted items.\n2. **Always draw**, even after forest Rest: one card plus one per face-up coins on track.')
add(18,'Explore, Quest, Repair','Explore: exhaust torch in ruin clearing, take one hidden item face up into Satchel/track, score 1 VP if item taken; remove ruin when its last item is taken, freeing slot. Quest: in matching clearing choose face-up quest, exhaust its two listed items, complete it; choose VP equal to matching completed quests including this one or draw two cards; draw replacement quest. Repair: exhaust hammer, move one damaged item to Satchel keeping its face; ready tea/coins/bags move to tracks if room.','Vagabond — Daylight','- **Explore:** Exhaust torch in ruin’s clearing. Take one hidden item face up into Satchel or track; score one VP if an item taken. Remove ruin when its last item is taken, freeing the building slot.\n- **Quest (matching clearing only):** Choose a face-up quest matching clearing; exhaust its **two listed items**, put quest in play area completed. Choose either VP equal to matching completed quests **including this one**, or draw two cards. Draw replacement quest into public display. No cards are spent to pay a quest.\n- **Repair:** Exhaust hammer; move one damaged item to Satchel **keeping current face**. Ready tea/coins/bags move to tracks if space.')
add(19,'Hostility, Infamy, Aid and Strike','Removing one warrior of a non-Hostile faction immediately makes it Hostile, except the allied-warrior hit comparison. In battle on Vagabond’s own turn, Infamy scores 1 extra VP per Hostile piece removed except the warrior that first caused Hostile; Hostile building/token removal normally scores 2 total (1 ordinary + 1 Infamy); no Infamy on others’ turns or from Strike. Aid cannot undo Hostility (though can take crafted item). Strike exhausts crossbow to remove one enemy warrior; only if enemy has no warriors there may remove another faction piece; Strike gives no Infamy.','Vagabond — Relationships/Hostile','- **Strike:** Exhaust crossbow to remove one enemy warrior in clearing. Only if that enemy has no warriors there may you remove another of its faction pieces instead. Check hostility. Strike is not battle and gives no Infamy.\n- **Hostile:** Removing **one** warrior of a non-Hostile faction immediately moves marker to Hostile (except allied battle-loss rule above). **Infamy:** During battle on your own turn, score **one extra VP per hostile piece removed**, except warrior that first made faction Hostile. **Each hostile building/token removed in battle on your turn normally scores two VP: one removal VP plus one Infamy. A hostile warrior scores one Infamy, except the warrior that first caused Hostile status.** Infamy depends on whose turn it is, rather than which side attacks: no Infamy on another player’s turn, and none from Strike. Hostile status requires extra boot for moves into hostile warriors, not merely buildings/tokens.\n- Aid cannot move marker out of Hostile; it can still obtain a crafted item. Coalition with Hostile faction resets its marker to Indifferent.')
add(20,'Coalition requirements and outcomes','With four or more players, during own Daylight at 10+ VP, Vagabond activates dominance to coalition with a player not already in coalition who has the lowest VP among players other than Vagabond (choose tie). Put Vagabond score marker on partner board and stop scoring. Vagabond also wins if partner wins, including by dominance. Hostile partner becomes Indifferent.','Vagabond coalition','**Vagabond coalition (9.2.8):** Cannot activate normal dominance win. With **four or more players**, during own Daylight at **at least 10 VP**, activate dominance to coalition with another player **not already in coalition**, whose VP is lowest among players other than you (choose among ties). Put your score marker on partner’s faction board and stop scoring. If partner wins, you also win, including if partner wins through dominance. Coalition partners are not enemies. A Hostile partner becomes Indifferent. Coalition does not by itself grant Allied relationship powers.')
add(21,'Rules precedence and cannot','Card overrides Law; Law overrides Learning to Play. Apply general and faction rules together when possible; if incompatible, faction rule wins. “Cannot” is absolute unless explicitly overridden.','Special Rules & Edge Cases — Precedence','- **Precedence:** Card overrides Law; Law overrides Learning to Play. Follow general and faction rules together when possible; if incompatible, faction rule wins. **Cannot is absolute** unless explicitly overridden. (1.1.)')
add(22,'Unclear simultaneous order and March interruption','If simultaneous effects lack clear order/decision maker, the player taking the turn chooses; for battle effects at same timing attacker chooses order. Marquise March’s two moves are one compound action and cannot be interrupted to spend a bird card or take another action.','Turn Structure; Marquise Daylight','Take turns clockwise: **Birdsong → Daylight → Evening**. “At start” effects precede all other phase effects; “at end” effects follow everything else in that phase, before next phase. Once the last step of a turn begins, no other actions are allowed except explicitly end-of-Evening/turn actions. An action, ability or persistent effect cannot be interrupted unless an effect explicitly permits it; a Marquise March’s two moves are one compound action. If simultaneous effects have no clear order or decision maker, the player taking the turn chooses. For battle effects at the same timing, attacker chooses their order. (1.1.3, 1.4, 4.3.)')
add(23,'At-start/end and last turn step','“At start” effects precede all other effects in that phase; “at end” effects follow all other phase effects before next phase. Once last step of a turn begins, no other actions are allowed except explicitly end-of-Evening/turn actions.','Turn Structure','Take turns clockwise: **Birdsong → Daylight → Evening**. “At start” effects precede all other phase effects; “at end” effects follow everything else in that phase, before next phase. Once the last step of a turn begins, no other actions are allowed except explicitly end-of-Evening/turn actions. An action, ability or persistent effect cannot be interrupted unless an effect explicitly permits it; a Marquise March’s two moves are one compound action.')
add(24,'Information, deals, card transfer/consent','Hand size is public, contents private; reveal/show only when instructed. Face-up piles may be searched/inspected; deck cannot. Agreements are non-binding; cards may be transferred only as instructed; actions require no consent.','Special Rules & Edge Cases — Cards','Hand size is public, contents private: reveal/show only if explicitly instructed. Face-up piles may be searched/inspected; deck cannot. Agreements are non-binding; cards may be transferred only as instructed; actions require no consent. (1.2–3.)')
add(25,'Deck empty and bird substitution','When shared deck empties, immediately shuffle discard into a new deck. Birds substitute for any non-bird suit, including multiple same-suit payments. If instructed to give/discard non-bird suit cards, birds must count as that suit; explicit bird-card requirement can only be paid with a bird.','Special Rules & Edge Cases — Cards','- **Cards:** Birds substitute for any non-bird suit, even for multiple same-suit payments. **If prompted to give or discard cards of a non-bird suit, you must treat your birds as that suit**; the instruction determines how many cards to give or discard. **Only a bird card can pay an explicit bird-card requirement; fox, rabbit and mouse cards cannot pay it.** Draw from shared deck top; when deck empties, immediately shuffle discard into new deck. (2.1.)')
add(26,'Piece shortages and proxies','Pieces are finite, no proxies. When told to place/take/remove more than possible, do the maximum possible and cannot voluntarily do fewer. Shortage does not waive costs/prerequisites or Eyrie’s obligation to complete Decree actions.','Actions — finite pieces','Pieces are finite: no proxies. When an instruction cannot place/take/remove all prompted pieces, **you must do the maximum possible and cannot voluntarily do fewer**; this never waives costs or prerequisites, nor the Eyrie’s obligation to complete Decree actions.')
add(27,'Piece source/destination, items, simultaneous removals','Place normally from supply or leftmost track space; remove normally to supply or rightmost empty track space; items removed from game are permanent.
